protocol: Validation extension only, 4/4/4 per size-family stratum; original train/test and validation instances unchanged; no score filtering.

distributions.uniform: independent uniform machine permutations; durations uniform integers 1..99
distributions.bottleneck: uniform routes and durations; one independently chosen machine durations multiplied by 4
distributions.heterogeneous: uniform routes; per-job factor uniformly 1/2/4; per-operation uniform 1..25 times factor, with independent 15% 4x outliers
distributions.correlated_routes: shared uniform machine permutation, max(1,m//5) random pair swaps per job; durations uniform 1..99

equivalence_check: All normalized duration/routing signatures differ; excludes job/machine relabeling and global scaling equivalences, without claiming general graph canonicalization.
